name: UGC 12588 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 12588, a spiral galaxy in Andromeda, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc12588-hubble
story: Nicknamed the cosmic cinnamon bun, this spiral has a round, mostly smooth center wrapped in faint, tightly wound arms, traced best by stars near its edges where new stars are likely forming.

claims.text: UGC 12588 is classified as a spiral galaxy
It lies in the constellation Andromeda
Its arms are faint and tightly wound, best traced by bluer stars near the edges marking likely star formation
